fusions.name: Parting Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays the first enemy within 5 tiles for 11 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Herd-Wide Alarm
fusions.desc: Stamps the alarm, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Marked] for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Mid-Step
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, and you bound 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Flag and Bolt
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack, 18% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
